FIELDS.NAME: Premium Floor Covering Solutions
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Premium Floor Covering Solutions, we specialize in the installation of high-quality residential carpet, hardwood, laminate, and vinyl flooring. Our operations focus on providing exceptional craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. We adhere strictly to industry standards and maintain a stringent safety program, ensuring our installers undergo regular training on installation techniques and equipment usage. We solely use pre-manufactured, non-toxic flooring materials sourced from reputable suppliers, guaranteeing safety and excellence in our services.

Our team is equipped to handle various flooring projects, performing installations with care and precision. We maintain all necessary licenses and workers' compensation coverage to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory standards. We do not engage in the removal or disturbance of hazardous materials, such as asbestos or lead, and we do not manufacture flooring materials, focusing instead on installation. 

Additionally, we have implemented a digital scheduling system for efficiency and customer convenience, along with a post-installation inspection process to ensure quality assurance and customer sign-off on completed work. Our commitment to safety, quality, and customer satisfaction positions us as a trusted choice for flooring solutions in our community.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 09/15/2022, Cause: Water damage during a flooring installation project due to a plumbing issue, Amount: $1,200, Status: Paid. Loss Date: 03/10/2023, Cause: Minor injury to an employee while handling flooring materials, Amount: $2,000, Status: Open.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and watchpersons in place during installations to secure job sites and prevent unauthorized access.
